title: Japanese Udon Noodle Stir Fry
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Japanese-inspired stir-fry using udon noodles, vegetables, and a hint of allspice.
instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat the quenched vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced carrots and bell peppers to the skillet and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the frozen peas, allspice, and cooked udon noodles to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve immediately.
